dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Distinctly concave trailing edge with a deep parabolic curvature transitioning from the posterior ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute-angled tip with a small rounding radius, pointing toward the posterior.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steeply inclined linear margin at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex, semi-spherical curvature from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak with a high thickness-to-length pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse angle at the junction where the melon slope meets the dorsal plane of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small circular depigmented lesions visible on the mid-flank and fine linear scratch markings along the lower lateral body.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharp color contrast boundary between a dark dorsal cape and a lighter gray-to-white ventral/lateral field.
